Quests.Title: Two Hearts, One Chassis
Quests.Summary: Jax can tune your own bike to resonate with your Attuned drakeling. Park it in his bay, fit the crystal coupler, choose the Ventwing handling profile, perform the first real fusion, ride his short course and separate safely.
Quests.Done: Fusion is yours: hold N on your own bike with an Attuned companion. Dante Rook at his forge has a canal actuator that needs your sample and your nerve.

Lines.Speaker: Jax Calder
Lines.Text: So the kid's sample is real. And your little drake hums at it. You know what that means? Nothing good for my insurance.

Lines.Speaker: Jax Calder
Lines.Text: Bring your own bike into the bay. Not a borrowed one, not a police toy, not a mission ride. Yours. Phone, Bring my bike, if it isn't with you.

Steps.Objective: Ride your own bike into Jax's bay and stop. Phone > Bring my bike if it is not with you.

Lines.Speaker: Jax Calder
Lines.Text: That's the one. Same scratches you left on my bumper last spring. Step off it a second.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to fit the crystal coupler
Steps.Objective: Step off and fit the crystal coupler to your bike.
Steps.Text: The coupler clicks home. A thin blue line of resonance runs along the frame.

Lines.Speaker: Jax Calder
Lines.Text: Coupler's in. It reads your drake and your frame at the same time and only lets them meet if both say yes.

Steps.Text: Ventwing handling. Updraft: a longer controlled glide, softer braking. Vent Brake: a hard cooling stop and a shorter burst. Jax can swap it later at the bay.
Steps.Name: FUSION PROFILE

Lines.Speaker: Jax Calder
Lines.Text: Get on. Hold N. If anything feels wrong, it rolls back on its own and you keep everything. I built it that way, because I like you and I like my walls.

Steps.Objective: Mount your bike in the bay and hold N to fuse with your drakeling.

Steps.Text: Fusion entitlement claimed: hold N on your own bike with an Attuned companion.

Lines.Speaker: Jax Calder
Lines.Text: Look at that. Ribs, wings, a head with an attitude. Ventwing. Don't scratch it.

Steps.Objective: Ride Jax's course: brake at the cones, use one vent glide (U), stop clean at the end.

Steps.Text: separate
Steps.Objective: Stop somewhere open and hold N to separate safely.

Steps.Text: Chassis trim choice waiting in your reward ledger: pick a look on the BUILD page.

Lines.Speaker: Jax Calder
Lines.Text: Clean split. Creature fine, bike fine, me only slightly older. Pick a trim. On the house. Once.

Lines.Speaker: Jax Calder
Lines.Text: Dante's been bothering me about you. Something about a cracked actuator in those canals. He's at his forge in Old Silver.

FailIf.Message: Lose the police first, then resume from the journal or the giver. Checkpoints are kept.

Quests.Floor: Jax's garage bay, ground floor, then a short course outside
Quests.Entrance: Jax Calder Customs bay door in the Ash Underpass

Quests.Title: Glass Under Pressure
Quests.Summary: A cracked actuator keeps the Ember Canals deadly. Compare two recipes at Dante's forge (or borrow his loaner rig), tune the cooled sample, fit the part in the canals and use the exposure window to make the transit loop safe.
Quests.Done: The canal loop is safe for return trips, and a salvage crew works it again. Bram Achterberg, keeper of the Pyre Gardens, has asked for you by name.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: Jax says your creature and your bike share a heartbeat now. Fine. Then they share a cooling problem.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: That canal actuator is cracked. A replacement wants tuning: frost salts, or ember glass. Or my loaner rig, if your pockets are empty. No shame in it.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to compare the two recipes
Steps.Objective: Compare the two tuning recipes on Dante's counter.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: Frost: two coolant salts, steady and slow. Ember: three ember crystals, fast and loud. The loaner does the job and leaves you nothing to sell.

Steps.Text: Which tuning will you use? Recipes you cannot afford are not offered; the loaner rig is always there.
Steps.Name: TUNING

Steps.Objective: Hand Dante two Coolant Salts.
Hand Dante three Ember Crystals.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to use Dante's loaner rig
Steps.Objective: Use Dante's loaner tuning rig.
Steps.Text: The loaner hums. Nothing spent, nothing to sell, job done.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to tune the recovered sample
Steps.Objective: Tune the cooled sample at the forge.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: Hear that ring? That's a part that wants to work. Take it down and fit it before it changes its mind.

Steps.Text: Coolant recipe added to the Forge: you can make this part yourself now.

Steps.Objective: Take the tuned part down to the canal actuator in the Ember Canals.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to fit the tuned actuator
Steps.Objective: Fit the tuned actuator.
Steps.Text: The actuator bites. Steam drops along the transit tunnel.
The tuned actuator opens a cool window across the transit tunnel. Scavengers will come for the heat it leaves.
Steps.Name: EXPOSURE WINDOW

Steps.Objective: Cross the transit tunnel while the window holds.
Drive off the ember scavengers in the transit tunnel. Three, nothing more.

Steps.Name: Wren Holt
Steps.Objective: Meet the salvage crew that followed the cool air in.

Lines.Speaker: Wren Holt
Lines.Text: You fixed the actuator? Then we can work the canals again. Hot metal, honest pay. We'll keep the loop clear for you.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: Watch the red channels. They don't care how honest you are.

Steps.Text: An augment choice waits in your reward ledger.

Lines.Speaker: Ion Solane (call)
Lines.Text: Bram Achterberg keeps the Pyre Gardens, one level down. He says his gardens are burning and his residents are frightened. He asked for you by name.

FailIf.Message: Lose the police first, then resume from the journal or the giver. Checkpoints are kept.

Quests.Floor: Dante's forge, then the canal actuator in the Ember Canals
Quests.Entrance: Dante Rook's Crystal Forge in Old Silver, then the canal gate below the refuge

Quests.Title: Gardens That Burn
Quests.Summary: The Pyre Gardens are alive and frightened. Study three residents before you judge them, choose a cooling route, lift an unstable seed-core free and hold the refuge boundary against one announced intrusion.
Quests.Done: The gardens still burn, but nothing hunts the boundary. A young Ashshell Warden chose you. Bram has a harder ask: the Cinder Matron.

Lines.Speaker: Bram Achterberg
Lines.Text: Mind the red glow, step on the blue. These gardens are alive, and half of what lives here is only frightened.

Lines.Speaker: Bram Achterberg
Lines.Text: Study three of my residents before you judge any of them. Then help me cool a path to the seed-core before it bursts.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to watch the cinder moths
Steps.Objective: Study the cinder moths near the warm crystal.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: Cinder moths. They drift toward warm crystal and dim when it cools. Harmless.

Lines.Speaker: Bram Achterberg
Lines.Text: They pollinate the fire crystal. Kill them and the garden starves.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to watch the kiln crab
Steps.Objective: Study the kiln crab by its burrow.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: Kiln crab. It clicks twice, then raises a claw. That's a warning, not a threat.

Lines.Speaker: Bram Achterberg
Lines.Text: Back off and it settles. Push and it defends its nest. Like anyone.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to watch the ember hatchlings
Steps.Objective: Study the ember hatchlings at the warm pool.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: Ember hatchlings, like Tamsin's. They follow warmth wherever it goes.

Lines.Speaker: Bram Achterberg
Lines.Text: And the extraction machines are taking the warmth. So the young ones wander up into your walls.

Steps.Text: Two ways to the seed-core. The pool route is long but cool. The root bridge is short and hot, where your ward has to face the heat.
Steps.Name: COOLING ROUTE

Steps.Objective: Take the long, cool pool route.

Steps.Text: Keep your ward up on the root bridge: the heat comes from the front.

Steps.Objective: Cross the hot root bridge, ward up.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to lift the seed-core free
Steps.Objective: Lift the unstable seed-core free.
Steps.Text: The unstable growth sighs and cools. The seed-core is warm in your hands, and growing.
Bram's cooled crystal tunes your ward: the Frostglass aspect is unlocked.
An extraction party follows the seed-core's heat to the refuge boundary. One announced wave and two reinforcements, no more.
Steps.Name: INTRUSION

Steps.Objective: Hold the refuge boundary. The declared wave, then two announced reinforcements.

Lines.Speaker: Bram Achterberg
Lines.Text: Look who stayed. A young ashshell warden. It watched you hold the line and decided you were worth following.

Lines.Speaker: Bram Achterberg
Lines.Text: Don't grab. Let it come to you.

Steps.Name: Ashshell warden
Steps.Objective: Let the young ashshell warden come to you: stay calm, then tune it with the chime.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: Heavy little thing. Built like a door.

Lines.Speaker: Bram Achterberg
Lines.Text: It braces things. Gates, ledges, you. Swap companions at any care station.

Steps.Text: Your ashshell warden trusts you now: Bonded. Its combat brace (U) is unlocked. Switch companions on the BONDS page or at a care station.
A fallen root is crushing a resident nest near the vista. Shifting it takes a minute and earns nothing but the garden's thanks.
Steps.Name: OPTIONAL RESCUE

Steps.Prompt: Press E to shift the fallen root off the nest
Steps.Objective: Shift the fallen root off the nest.
Steps.Text: The root rolls clear. Three hatchlings blink up at you, unharmed.

Lines.Speaker: Bram Achterberg
Lines.Text: The extraction lures are worse below the vista. They're hammered into the Cinder Matron's nesting ground, screaming orders at her.

Lines.Speaker: Bram Achterberg
Lines.Text: Rest, mend, then come back to me. We are going to have to face her.

FailIf.Message: Lose the police first, then resume from the journal or the giver. Checkpoints are kept.

Quests.Entrance: The Ember Canals passage to the gardens

Quests.Title: The Cinder Matron
Quests.Summary: The Cinder Matron is a displaced mother driven by extraction lures. Tear out the three lures, cross the matron gate, survive her three phases using the cooled crystal plates, then decide her fate.
Quests.Done: The Matron is spent but alive, the arena is quiet and its exit stands open. Iris Moon wants to know who wrote those extraction orders.

Lines.Speaker: Bram Achterberg
Lines.Text: The Cinder Matron is not a monster. She's a mother with three lures hammered into her nest, screaming extraction orders at her.

Lines.Speaker: Bram Achterberg
Lines.Text: Pull the lures and she'll still fight you, but she'll fight you, not the whole garden. Cool the crystal plates near her and her shell opens.

Lines.Speaker: Bram Achterberg
Lines.Text: Your companion helps if it's with you. If it's resting, you can still win. Her pattern is fair.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to tear out the extraction lure
Steps.Objective: Tear out the first extraction lure.
Steps.Text: The lure sparks and dies.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to tear out the extraction lure
Steps.Objective: Tear out the second extraction lure.
Steps.Text: Two down. Somewhere below, something roars.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to tear out the extraction lure
Steps.Objective: Tear out the last extraction lure.
Steps.Text: Silence. Then footsteps, very large ones.

Steps.Objective: Step through the matron gate. The arena boundary glows once the fight starts.
Survive the Cinder Matron: cool the crystal plates, hit her opened shell.

Lines.Speaker: Bram Achterberg
Lines.Text: Ward up when she inhales. Cool plates open her shell. Three moods: angry, desperate, tired. Get her to tired.

Steps.Text: Your ashshell warden stood with you against the Matron: Attuned. Jax can calibrate its Kilnback form at his bay.
The arena is quiet. Its exit stands open, and the plates cool to a dull glow.

The Matron lies spent but alive. Contain her in the old cooling pen, where Bram can tend her: her scattered young come home and the gardens settle. Or relocate her to the deep habitat, wild again: her nest stays empty and the deep vents get rougher.
Steps.Name: THE MATRON

Lines.Speaker: Bram Achterberg
Lines.Text: The pen it is. I'll keep her fed and the lures far away. She'll guard the gardens from inside a fence, and that's not nothing.

Steps.Text: From now on her scattered hatchlings sleep by the pen, and the habitat crab no longer warns you off. Bram's crew will post feed runs on the refuge board.

Lines.Speaker: Bram Achterberg
Lines.Text: Wild, then. The deep vents will be rougher with her in them, but they'll be hers, and the machines will think twice.

Steps.Text: From now on her nest stays empty: her brood follows her down to sleep in the Ash Reliquary rest room. The refuge board will post rescues of her strays.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: Somebody wrote those lures an order. Orders have authors.

Lines.Speaker: Bram Achterberg
Lines.Text: Then go up and find one. Iris Moon at the Resonance Archive collects authors. Tell her Bram sent you; she owes me a lantern.

FailIf.Message: Lose the police first, then resume from the journal or the giver. Checkpoints are kept.

Quests.Floor: The Matron's arena below the gardens vista
Quests.Entrance: The matron gate in the Pyre Gardens
